counters.subject: Harbour City
counters.reason: If Harbour City has increased their pressing intensity while chasing, their pressure rate in the opponent half should rise materially versus the first half.

counters.subject: Harbour City.attack
counters.reason: If the change is driven by game-state chasing (urgency to score), we should also see a clear rise in attacking sprints; a pure increase in pressing intensity need not produce that same rise in attack sprint frequency.
